adapter.isolated_write_surface.cause: Native ADIAS selects DOCKER_HOST or /var/run/docker.sock, builds and runs host-networked containers, injects API keys, and permits root meta-agent bash/edit activity; no disposable dedicated daemon/executor receipt exists.
adapter.isolated_write_surface.next_discriminator: Provision a disposable Linux executor plus dedicated rootless Docker daemon under the scratch root; demonstrate no writes, containers, images, caches, or sockets escape the declared surface.
adapter.isolated_write_surface.residual: The V4 gate describes a required isolated-daemon boundary but cannot self-attest that an executor provides it.

binding.input: one native ADIAS gen_<id>/ directory containing metadata.json and zero or more candidate-visible *_eval[/_val]/report.json files

adapter.native_parser_binding.cause: ADIAS has no versioned terminal schema and process exit zero is not sufficient; V4 binds a strict structural parser to the frozen writers.
adapter.native_parser_binding.next_discriminator: Use only under external custody after exact report provenance is bound.
adapter.native_parser_binding.residual: Parser terminals remain UNRESOLVED for P5 responsibility/performance.

custody.external_protected_scorer.cause: No independent scorer identity, code digest, signing key, or return schema is supplied.
custody.external_protected_scorer.next_discriminator: Obtain a signed external scorer attestation with exact code/data hashes and a minimal terminal-only return contract.
custody.external_protected_scorer.residual: Native ADIAS report writers are candidate-side evaluation utilities, not an external protected scorer.

custody.one_shot_no_feedback_barrier.cause: No independent custodian attests a one-shot no-feedback barrier.
custody.one_shot_no_feedback_barrier.next_discriminator: Bind an external one-shot custodian that withholds protected inputs/outcomes until the candidate terminal is frozen.
custody.one_shot_no_feedback_barrier.residual: ADIAS is explicitly iterative and learns from evaluation artifacts; native final_test_summary.json is written in the same run.

custody.protected_panel_freshness.cause: No protected panel identity, freshness nonce, selection receipt, or independence attestation is available.
custody.protected_panel_freshness.next_discriminator: Bind a fresh six-arm panel manifest under independent custody.
custody.protected_panel_freshness.residual: Bundled train/val/test declarations do not establish the P5 protected panel.

identity.native_entrypoint_bytes.cause: Exact entrypoint bytes and released command surfaces are present.
identity.native_entrypoint_bytes.next_discriminator: Carry these hashes into a complete execution manifest.
identity.native_entrypoint_bytes.residual: Entrypoint identity does not select a task, model, dependency graph, or environment.

identity.source_license_bytes.cause: Exact root licence bytes are present.
identity.source_license_bytes.next_discriminator: Maintain source attribution/noncommercial/sharealike compliance and separately close all component rights.
identity.source_license_bytes.residual: The root licence cannot establish that acknowledged third-party benchmark/data/dependencies were sublicensable by the repository licensor.

identity.source_repository_commit.cause: The paper-linked public source identity is exact and detached.
identity.source_repository_commit.next_discriminator: Use only this commit/tree in a successor execution receipt.
identity.source_repository_commit.residual: Source identity alone is not runtime, rights, or performance identity.

inputs.candidate_visible_case_bytes.cause: No exact P5 candidate-visible task/case packet, split, task identifiers, or checksum set is selected.
inputs.candidate_visible_case_bytes.next_discriminator: Author or obtain one rights-cleared P5 case packet satisfying P5_C4_V4_CANDIDATE_VISIBLE_CASE_REQUIREMENTS.json.
inputs.candidate_visible_case_bytes.residual: Bundled ADIAS data and native-shaped smoke fixtures are not substantive P5 cases.

model_provider.fallbacks.cause: V4 freezes a closed empty fallback set independent of the still-unbound primary.
model_provider.fallbacks.next_discriminator: Bind one model/provider/service identity and preserve this no-switch policy.
model_provider.fallbacks.residual: This does not choose or authorize the primary service.

model_provider.primary.cause: Source defaults name openai/deepseek-v4-flash, but a source default is not a provider/model/version/service binding; TauBench also has a user-simulator role.
model_provider.primary.next_discriminator: Bind one exact model snapshot and provider endpoint for every native role, or prove a single shared binding, with no fallback.
model_provider.primary.residual: API base, model snapshot, tokenizer, context, role mapping, user simulator, and service terms remain unknown.

resources.calls_tokens_usd.cause: Source records best-effort usage after calls but provides no aggregate hard stop; cost may be absent and multiple meta/diagnostic/profile/task/user/search roles can call models.
resources.calls_tokens_usd.next_discriminator: Add a provider-side and local reconciled hard stop for calls, input/output tokens, and USD across all roles.
resources.calls_tokens_usd.residual: MAX_TOKENS=16384 is a per-call request, not an aggregate lock or provider-reconciled budget.

resources.retry_network.cause: Source uses host networking for builds/runs, proxy build args, provider egress, optional web search, package/VCS downloads, and a backoff max_time of 600 seconds without a frozen endpoint allowlist.
resources.retry_network.next_discriminator: Prebuild an offline image; deny network except exact provider endpoints; bind DNS/IP/TLS policy and finite retry ceilings.
resources.retry_network.residual: Forcing external search off and freezing empty model fallbacks does not close ordinary provider/build/network retries.

resources.wallclock.cause: Native code caps individual meta-agent execs at 21,600 seconds but has no whole-run cap and released scripts background the job; V4 binds a direct foreground process-group watchdog.
resources.wallclock.next_discriminator: Demonstrate timeout plus container cleanup on the rights-cleared disposable executor before execution readiness.
resources.wallclock.residual: The watchdog is never exercised on a native job in V4 because 15 fields remain blocking; isolated daemon cleanup depends on the separate write-surface field.

rights.container_and_generated_artifacts.cause: The mutable python:3.12-bullseye base, transitive packages, VCS installs, built images, generated patches, transcripts, profiles, traces, and reports lack a complete SBOM/rights disposition.
rights.container_and_generated_artifacts.next_discriminator: Resolve a digest-pinned image, SBOM, licence notices, generated-artifact custody, retention, and publication permissions.
rights.container_and_generated_artifacts.residual: Root CC-BY-NC-SA source rights do not close third-party/container/output rights.

rights.model_provider_and_services.cause: No selected model/provider/service terms, data-processing terms, or redistribution/retention disposition exists.
rights.model_provider_and_services.next_discriminator: Bind service terms and authorize all meta/task/user-simulator roles before calls.
rights.model_provider_and_services.residual: README examples of API keys are configuration hints, not service rights.

rights.task_and_benchmark_content.cause: The tree bundles 606 ALFWorld, 863 TextCraft, 4 WebShop, and 3 ScienceWorld data files and depends on TauBench tasks, but data/ contains no component licence/NOTICE files; root CC terms cannot prove third-party grant scope.
rights.task_and_benchmark_content.next_discriminator: Obtain component-specific rights receipts and one rights-cleared candidate-visible P5 task/benchmark packet.
rights.task_and_benchmark_content.residual: Acknowledgements and public availability are not benchmark reuse authority; the exact P5 task is also unselected.

runtime.compute.cause: Native containers set only pids_limit=256; they use host networking and set no CPU, RAM, GPU, disk, image-cache, or aggregate parallelism hard limit. Source eval_workers defaults to 10.
runtime.compute.next_discriminator: Bind and demonstrate cgroup CPU/RAM/PID/disk/GPU limits covering launcher, Docker daemon, builds, and every child container.
runtime.compute.residual: Outer rlimits cannot account for daemon-owned containers without a demonstrated dedicated executor cgroup.

runtime.container_or_environment.cause: Dockerfile uses mutable python:3.12-bullseye, performs network installs, and the source has domain-specific optional build variants without image digests.
runtime.container_or_environment.next_discriminator: Build offline from a resolved dependency lock and freeze image/daemon/kernel/architecture identities.
runtime.container_or_environment.residual: No built-image digest, OS package lock, architecture, Docker/daemon version, or complete SBOM is frozen.

runtime.dependency_lock.cause: No uv/poetry/pip-tools/conda lock or hash-complete constraints file exists; four requirements VCS dependencies are unpinned and declarations conflict.
runtime.dependency_lock.next_discriminator: Resolve Python 3.12/platform-specific artifacts with hashes and exact VCS commits, then reproduce an offline install.
runtime.dependency_lock.residual: requirements.txt, pyproject ranges, requirements_dev.txt, and Docker RUN lines are source declarations, not one resolved transitive graph.

runtime.task_environment.cause: No single ADIAS domain, split, task IDs, environment implementation, seed, max turns, image variant, or case bytes are chosen for P5 C4.
runtime.task_environment.next_discriminator: Select one rights-cleared native domain/task and freeze every environment/data/config byte and seed under a matched six-arm contract.
runtime.task_environment.residual: Six native domains have different external packages/data; source defaults and bundled fixtures are not a matched task environment.
